Sp. Br. Registry.

Foreign Affairs
Station Crime & Special Branch File No. Date July 5th 1943.

SUBJECT: Re: INDIAN SPORTING ASSOCIATION

At 2.30 p.m. on 4th July, 1943, 12th Annual General meeting of Indian Sporting Association was held at CHINESE Y.M.C.A. 593 Szechuen Road. In the opening Chanan Singh (Sandhu) president of the Association delivered a brief speech and thanked the members for their presence. Annual report of the Association was read out by Secretary Tara Singh (Feruman). Arjan Singh (Gharka) auditor mentioned few remarks regarding the accounts, which were replied by the Treasurer satisfied him. The accounts were found correct. A resolution was passed that the Annual membership fee be raised from $12 to $25.

The New Committee of the following were elected for the year of 1943-1944:

TARA SINGH (FERUMAN)......President
CHANAN SINGH (SANDHU).....Secretary
TARA SINGH (LAHNEKE JAND) Treasurer
SAPURAN SINGH (VAKIL).....Hockey Captain
AJAIB SINGH (JHASAL)......Vice- " "
NAZIR HUSSAIN.............Football Captain
NARYAN SINGH..............Vice- " "

Meeting came to an end at 5.30 p.m. which was attended by 68 members, refreshment was served and music was played by four Indians.

Narain Singh
S.D.C. 4106

Crime & Special Branch.

主题：关于印度体育协会

1943年7月4日下午2时30分，印度体育协会第十二届年度大会在四川路593号中华基督教青年会举行。会议开始时，协会主席查南·辛格（Sandhu）（音译）发表了简短讲话，并感谢会员出席。秘书塔拉·辛格（Feruman）（音译）宣读了协会年度报告。审计员阿尔詹·辛格（Gharka）（音译）就账目提出几点意见，司库作了答复，使其满意。账目经查无误。会议通过一项决议，将会费由每年12元提高至25元。

选举产生1943-1944年度新一届委员会成员如下：

塔拉·辛格（FERUMAN）（音译）......主席
查南·辛格（SANDHU）（音译）.....秘书
塔拉·辛格（LAHNEKE JAND）（音译） 司库
萨普兰·辛格（VAKIL）（音译）.....曲棍球队长
阿贾伊布·辛格（JHASAL）（音译）..副队长
纳齐尔·侯赛因.............足球队长
纳里扬·辛格..............副队长

会议于下午5时30分结束，共有68名会员出席，会上供应茶点，并由四名印度人演奏音乐。

纳莱恩·辛格
特别侦探警员 4106

SUBJECT: Application for financial help by the Indian Sporting Association:-
1. Name of organization - Indian Sporting Association.
2. Office - 179 Point Road.
3. Chairman:-
A. Name: Chanan Singh Sandhu
B. Age: 37
C. Nationality: Indian
D. Address: 110 Woosung Road
E. Profession: Clerk
F. Place of employment: General Post Office (Dead Letter Office)
4. Date of formation - 17th Sept. 1933.
5. Object - Sports.
6. Membership:- A. Members 56
B. Nationalities: Indians
C. Profession: Merchants, watchmen, policemen, money lenders and clerks
7. Membership fee:-
A. Entrance fee $4
B. Membership fee $12 per annum
The said Association was formed on 17th Sept. 1933 and called Khalsa Sporting Association. The word "Khalsa" means pure and used only for sikhs. All members of the Association were sikhs, therefore it was called Khalsa Sporting Association.
In this year, the name of the Association has been changed into Indian Sporting Association. This is done so that the non-sikhs may join the Association.

1. 组织名称 - 印度体育协会。

D. 地址：吴淞路110号

5. 宗旨 - 体育。
6. 会员情况：- A. 会员人数 56人

7. 会费：-
A. 入会费 4元
B. 年费 每年12元
该协会成立于1933年9月17日，初名为“卡尔萨体育协会”。“卡尔萨”一词意为纯洁，仅用于锡克教徒。该协会所有成员均为锡克教徒，因此称为卡尔萨体育协会。
今年，协会名称已改为印度体育协会。此举旨在允许非锡克教徒加入协会。
